name: Ruat Caelum
selection_basis: existing Fiat Justitia Ruat Caelum system identity
explicit separation between legal technology execution and legal data truth
descendant_families: case matrices and structured legal data
routing_rule: Route legal data, evidence, docket metadata, chronology, provenance, and case-record discovery through Ruat Caelum. Open the owning source repository before asserting a fact, provenance state, filing state, authenticity state, or evidentiary conclusion.
authority_boundary: Ruat Caelum governs legal-data routing and provenance, not legal-technology execution. It does not transform generated work product into evidence, overwrite source facts, or supersede The Statue of Liberty as the broader legal authority.
identity_note: No standalone GlacierEQ/ruat-caelum repository exists in the current GitHub inventory. Ruat Caelum is therefore a scoped logical head hosted by GlacierEQ/fiat-justitia until a separately verified successor repository is established.
